blocks.html: Hydrogen fuel gas rooms shall not be used for storage of gaseous hydrogen in quantities exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area set forth in Table 307.1(1). Where approved by the Fire Department, such hydrogen fuel gas rooms permitted to store greater quantities shall be classified as Occupancy Group H.
